title: Cornered by The Guavian Death Gang
description: Rey continues to argue with Han Solo until a loud thud echoes through the Millennium Falcon. "Don't tell me a rathtar's gotten loose ..." Han groans. "What's a rathtar?" Rey asks. "They're big and dangerous," Han explains gruffly. He leads them out of the Falcon to check on the beasts. It isn't Han Solo's fearsome cargo making the racket, though. The Guavian Death Gang is aboard the Falcon. Han owes the gang money, and they are there to collect.
